Open Book With Many Secrets

by Bhavya Kamdar

Mr. Anthony Oliver's life changes when he meets "the most beautiful girl" in his dreams. He starts becoming less professional and more personal about his life, highly influenced by someone he isn't even sure exists — because he has only ever met her there, asleep.

Read the book to find out: does the most beautiful girl exist at all?
